title: PureUP: AQI Based Air Quality Improver
shortDescription: FastAPI-based API and e-Commerce platform recommending optimal indoor plants using voting-based ML models.
fullDescription: PureUP is an environmental health intelligence platform. It processes environmental metrics (PM2.5, PM10, humidity, temperature) to recommend specific air-purifying plants tailored to individual rooms and climates using an ensemble voting model.
highlights: Engineered a multi-classifier voting model achieving 90% prediction accuracy over 500+ diverse environmental inputs.
Built resilient RESTful API endpoints in FastAPI with automated Pydantic schema validation.
Successfully deployed on Render cloud infrastructure, maintaining 99% uptime under active daily usage.
Integrated front-end eCommerce catalog enabling users to immediately purchase recommended plant species.

title: Aura: Health Habit Tracker
shortDescription: Full-stack preventative health habit tracking platform with Google Firestore and LLM-driven personalized coaching.
fullDescription: Aura helps users build long-term wellness routines by monitoring key lifestyle signals and delivering dynamically generated workout regimes, nutritional plans, and real-time encouragement through the Google Gemini LLM.
highlights: Designed full-stack application with Python and Flask integrated with Google Cloud Firestore for real-time state synchronization.
Tracked and analyzed 4+ key daily health dimensions: sleep duration, physical activity, calorie balance, and mood states.
Leveraged Google Gemini API to dynamically generate 3 bespoke content streams: customized exercise plans, meal recipes, and motivational reinforcement.
Implemented responsive data visualization charts displaying weekly habit consistency and trend analysis.

title: AI-Powered Study Buddy
shortDescription: Autonomous AI learning assistant architecting structured 3-day syllabi, scheduled alerts, and adaptive content.
fullDescription: An interactive learning acceleration tool built with Streamlit. Given any complex subject, the agent deconstructs the topic into an actionable 3-day mastery milestone, generates in-depth study notes, and automates reminder emails.
highlights: Architected 3 core automated features: comprehensive study guide synthesis, micro-schedule generation, and automated email progress triggers.
Engineered structured prompt chains with Google Gemini API to formulate rigorous 3-day roadmaps for complex STEM topics.
Built an intuitive and responsive Streamlit interface providing 2 distinct content presentation modes (conceptual vs quiz-driven).
Automated reminder dispatch using Python SMTPlib to keep students accountable throughout their learning sprint.
